name: AvatarGroup
summary: Overlapping stack of avatars, with a count for the ones that do not fit.

a11y.apg: none: a row of portraits is a group, so it takes role=group and a name. The count is aria-hidden because it repeats what the group already says.

props.name: children
props.description: REQUIRED. The Avatar elements. They overlap in source order.

props.name: max
props.description: How many to show. The rest become a single count. Without it, every avatar is shown.

props.name: total
props.description: Use when the real total lives on the server and only a page of avatars was sent.

props.name: label
props.description: Whose faces these are. A row of portraits with no name says nothing.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the count bubble, so it matches the avatars beside it — pass the same value you passed them. It was a number until 06/08/2026; the debt is paid and the scale is Avatar's.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.
